title: C4OS Grill Question 016 - Plugin Settings Schema

questions.label: What field types should plugin settings support in v1?
questions.help: Recommended: string, text, boolean, number, and enum arrays. This covers your example while keeping form rendering predictable.
options: string, text, boolean, number, and enum arrays
string, text, boolean, and enum arrays only

questions.label: Which plugin settings keys should the app shell reserve?
questions.help: Recommended: reserve `panel` and `enabled` only for v1. Keep icon order separate because header drag/drop owns it.
options: Reserve any key listed in a shell namespace
Do not reserve keys; use separate shell config only

questions.label: Notes or corrections
questions.help: Clarify validation, defaults, labels/help text, secret fields, or whether plugins can hide settings conditionally.
